look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Look at a small annual grass with narrow leaves and a relatively stiff, often one-sided, narrow panicle. Examine its crowded, laterally compressed multi-flowered spikelets on short angular branches; verify spikelet florets and a blunt membranous ligule rather than guessing from grass habit.
